Name: GMCM Advanced Search
Author: ThaleMagnus
Description:

Instead of scrolling through a long GMCM list trying to remember which mod added which setting, press F2 (configurable) and search directly.

The main page starts with an alphabetical author list. Click an author to see their mods, then click a mod to open its GMCM page. You can also search directly for any keyword you want.

Search supports:

* Author names
* Mod names
* Unique IDs
* Nexus IDs
* Config option names

Search results are grouped by mod, so matching settings appear under the mod they belong to.

This is especially helpful for large mod lists, troubleshooting, or quickly finding that one setting you know exists but cannot remember where it lives.

It is also comes with its own [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] app.

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
